info.title: RiktigRefactor.CSharp.Tool
info.description: Behavior-preserving C# refactorings. Refuses when it cannot prove a change is safe.

options.name: --help
options.description: Show help and usage information

options.name: --version
options.description: Show version information

commands.name: rename
commands.description: Rename a symbol and every reference to it. Exits 0 on success, 1 when refused, 2 on error.

options.name: --workspace
options.description: The .sln, .slnx or .csproj to load.

options.name: --file
options.description: The file containing the symbol or selection.

options.name: --at
options.description: The cursor position as line:column, both 1-based.

options.name: --new-name
options.description: The new identifier.

options.name: --apply
options.description: Write the changes to disk instead of only previewing them. [default: False]

options.name: --json
options.description: Print the result as JSON, using the shared protocol. [default: False]

commands.name: extract-iife
commands.description: Wrap the selected expression or statements in an immediately-invoked static lambda. Exits 0 on success, 1 when refused, 2 on error.

options.name: --workspace
options.description: The .sln, .slnx or .csproj to load.

options.name: --file
options.description: The file containing the symbol or selection.

options.name: --from
options.description: The start of the selection as line:column, both 1-based.

options.name: --to
options.description: The end of the selection (exclusive) as line:column, both 1-based.

options.name: --apply
options.description: Write the changes to disk instead of only previewing them. [default: False]

options.name: --json
options.description: Print the result as JSON, using the shared protocol. [default: False]

commands.name: make-method-static
commands.description: Turn the instance method at the cursor into a static method that takes the receiver as its first parameter. Exits 0 on success, 1 when refused, 2 on error.

options.name: --workspace
options.description: The .sln, .slnx or .csproj to load.

options.name: --file
options.description: The file containing the symbol or selection.

options.name: --at
options.description: The cursor position as line:column, both 1-based.

options.name: --receiver-name
options.description: The name of the new receiver parameter. Defaults to the type's name in camel case.

options.name: --apply
options.description: Write the changes to disk instead of only previewing them. [default: False]

options.name: --json
options.description: Print the result as JSON, using the shared protocol. [default: False]

commands.name: move-static-member
commands.description: Move the static member at the cursor to another type, and update every reference. Exits 0 on success, 1 when refused, 2 on error.

options.name: --workspace
options.description: The .sln, .slnx or .csproj to load.

options.name: --file
options.description: The file containing the symbol or selection.

options.name: --at
options.description: The cursor position as line:column, both 1-based.

options.name: --target
options.description: The namespace-qualified name of the type to move the member to, such as Shop.Pricing.

options.name: --apply
options.description: Write the changes to disk instead of only previewing them. [default: False]

options.name: --json
options.description: Print the result as JSON, using the shared protocol. [default: False]

commands.name: convert-to-instance-method
commands.description: Turn the static method at the cursor into an instance method on the type of one of its parameters. Exits 0 on success, 1 when refused, 2 on error.

options.name: --workspace
options.description: The .sln, .slnx or .csproj to load.

options.name: --file
options.description: The file containing the symbol or selection.

options.name: --at
options.description: The cursor position as line:column, both 1-based.

options.name: --receiver
options.description: The name of the parameter that becomes the receiver.

options.name: --apply
options.description: Write the changes to disk instead of only previewing them. [default: False]

options.name: --json
options.description: Print the result as JSON, using the shared protocol. [default: False]
